text:
Maya: Quick question — we're onboarding a third-party analytics service and they asked for a write API key. Do we prefer issuing a short-lived key via Vault or sharing a KMS-wrapped static key for now?

Sam: i'd avoid static keys if possible. short-lived Vault tokens are easier to revoke and rotate. :+1:

Jordan: Agree. How does the CI job pick up the Vault token? we currently mount `vault-ci` with read-only policy, but service needs write to /analytics.

Maya: We'd need a new policy scope. Planning: create role `analytics/writer` that can create creds scoped to the service account, TTL 12h. Ops approval needed though.

Alex: FYI: make sure we redact the key from startup logs — last time an env leaked in worker logs during rollout. ops-bot runbook says to scrub `SERVICE_*` envs but analytics uses `ANALYTICS_API` var.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/log-redaction — ensure `LOG_REDACTION_PATTERNS` includes `ANALYTICS_API`.

Sam: Good catch. Maya — can you paste the minimal example we will put in the deployment manifest so I can review the redaction config?

Maya: Sure, snippet below (will mount Vault via CSI and inject env var):

```yaml
env:
  - name: ANALYTICS_API
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: analytics-api-secret
        key: key
```

Jordan: On the redaction side, we currently have a regex that scrubs `(?i)(api|token|secret)=\S+`. Might not catch `ANALYTICS_API` if it's `ANALYTICS_API: abc123` in logs. Add pattern for uppercase underscore vars.

Alex: Suggest adding `(?i)[A-Z0-9_]*API[_A-Z0-9]*[:=]\s*\S+` to be safe. test in staging before prod.

Maya: Noted. For Vault flow: 1) request for `analytics-writer` role 2) security approves 3) infra creates policy + role 4) update CI job to request creds. Who can approve step 2? @Sam or @Alex?

Sam: I can approve the policy but want to see the minimal policy JSON first.

Jordan: I'll draft the policy. Minimal allowance: `kv/data/analytics/*` (read/write) and `auth/approle/login` restricted to CI role. TTL 12h, max 24h.

Maya: Also need to confirm if we should enable KMS-wrapping for a backup static key in case Vault is unavailable. Ops opinion?

Alex: Keep it as backup. If you create a KMS-wrapped key, ensure it's marked "backup-only" and not used unless Vault health checks fail. Add automated rotation schedule (90d) and document in the incident playbook.

Sam: Approve contingent on Jordan's policy and a staging test that verifies redaction in logs. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Policy draft (shortened):
```json
{
  "path": {
    "kv/data/analytics/*": ["create","read","update","delete"],
    "auth/approle/login": ["read"]
  }
}
```

Maya: Thanks. I've opened a PR with the deployment manifest and added the redaction regex change to `observability-config` here: https://stash.redwood/Internal/PR/4521 — please review.

Alex: Reviewing now. Also add a note to the playbook to rotate the KMS-wrapped backup every 90 days and to test Vault failover monthly.

Maya: Will do. Estimated timeline: infra + security approval by EOD Friday, CI patch and staging test next week.

Sam: Sounds good. Ping me for the policy PR link once it's up.

ops-bot: Action items created: #1234 (create Vault role), #1235 (update redaction regex), #1236 (add KMS backup doc).

Maya: Thanks all — closing the loop here. If anyone sees a gap, reply and I'll keep the thread updated. :pray:
